status.description: Derived from the group states over the groups that are not CANCELLED (ADR 0002 A1, A23). LOST and RETURNED are terminal: every such group is LOST or RETURNED (LOST when any is lost) and none was delivered; a mix of delivered and lost or returned groups, all closed, is PARTIALLY_DELIVERED.
status.title: OrderStatus

status.description: PROMISED (no node locked), LOCKED (FulfillmentLocked), SHIPPED (FulfillmentShipped), DELIVERED (every package delivered), CANCELLATION_REQUESTED (CustomerOrderCancelled published, order-sourcing has not answered), CANCELLED (FulfillmentCancelled or an unkeepable promise), LOST (PackageLost for a package of the group) and RETURNED (PackageReturned), both terminal.
status.title: GroupStatus

timeZone.description: IANA time zone of the delivery station serving the destination: the local calendar deliverByEarliest and deliverByLatest belong to. Convert both instants into it before taking a date or an hour (e.g. 2026-10-31T14:00:00Z..2026-11-01T02:00:00Z in America/Chicago is the single day 2026-10-31, 9 AM to 9 PM). Copied from delivery-promise (its ADR 0011). Optional and additive (ADR 0009): omitted when unknown, i.e. for a group or offer delivery-promise stored before it carried the zone; read the window in UTC then.
timeZone.title: TimeZone

lostAt.description: When a package of the group was declared lost (PackageLost); set when the group is LOST.

returnedAt.description: When a package of the group was returned to the sender (PackageReturned); set when the group is RETURNED.

outcomePackage.description: The tracking number named by PackageLost or PackageReturned; set when the group is LOST or RETURNED.

state.description: The package journey state from PackageScanned (LABELLED .. DELIVERED, RETURNED, LOST) or VOIDED after LabelVoided.

etaStart.description: Start of the day-of delivery window of the package. Present only while the package is OUT_FOR_DELIVERY and the window was assigned at or after the last scan; omitted otherwise (a failed attempt, a newer scan or any terminal state hides it). Shown as received, never clipped to the promised window.

etaEnd.description: End of the day-of delivery window, present exactly when etaStart is.

reason.description: Why the delivery point was flagged (two counted failed attempts). A code for the storefront to word; never prose from the driver.

deliveryPointAdvisory.description: The delivery-point advisory (ADR 0015). Present while the package has not ended (not DELIVERED, RETURNED, LOST or VOIDED); absent means no flag arrived. It is an advisory only - not an address change, not instructions, not a notification.

detail.example: Every shipment group is locked to a node; cancellation is now a return.
